resources.string:
HHPhone — SIP phone for HHPBX and other SIP PBXs

Version %1$s

Voice and video calls, several accounts, TLS and SRTP.

The coloured dot next to an account shows its registration: green — registered, yellow — in progress, red — failed, white — disabled. Touch it to open the account.

Source code

github.com/TheRainOfSoul/HHPhone (GNU GPL).

Based on baresip+ by TutPro Inc. (BSD 3-Clause) and the baresip library.
